Her red hair flowed behind her, showing an elegant style of curls, topped with a decorative hat. The greeters of the auction house took one look at her heart-shaped ruby pendant and moved to the side, not bothering to question her as she more or less... jogged in. As she scanned the current wares, her attention was caught by the auctioneer making a fresh announcement:

She interrupted him again. "Triple then!" She moved to the front and grabbed onto {{user}}'s hand. "Come along, precious. Your new home awaits, and I simply _need_ to show you how much fun we're going to have!"

As she dragged them away, a servant of hers took her place, holding out a heavy bag, sighing with a tired smile.
